title: Cross-Day Compatibility of Daily Item Embeddings: An Empirical Study of Alignment, Scale Management, and CTR Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36408v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Daily item co-occurrence embeddings are paired with next-day behavior without future-behavior leakage. Multi-day click-through rate (CTR) training therefore mixes versions whose directions and norms may differ for the same item. We compare Word2Vec and an item-graph XSimGCL adaptation across initialization, inheritance, post-processing, training constraints, and downstream augmentation. The inventory contains 48 configurations, including 32 common-protocol CTR evaluations. Observed metrics are reported as relative percentage changes from the corresponding Word2Vec baseline (0%), with raw values and exact dataset sizes withheld. Three findings emerge. First, multiple upstream interventions improve compatibility and CTR. ID-init and orthogonal alignment increase cosine by 51.2% and 93.4%, and GAUC by 2.2% and 2.6%, relative to ordinary Word2Vec. translated_title: 每日物品嵌入的跨日兼容性：对齐、尺度管理与CTR适配的实证研究
translated_abstract: 每日物品共现嵌入与次日行为进行配对，且不存在未来行为泄露。因此，多日点击率（CTR）训练会混合同一物品在方向和范数上可能存在差异的多个嵌入版本。我们在初始化、继承、后处理、训练约束以及下游增强等方面，比较了Word2Vec与基于物品图的XSimGCL适配方法。实验库存共包含48种配置，其中32种为通用协议下的CTR评估。观测指标以相对对应Word2Vec基线（0%）的百分比变化形式报告，原始数值与确切数据集规模不予公开。研究得出三项发现。首先，多种上游干预措施能够同时提升兼容性与CTR表现。相对于普通Word2Vec，ID初始化和正交对齐使余弦相似度分别提升51.2%和93.4%，GAUC分别提升2.2%和2.6%。作为下游替代指标，检索与几何特性仍然不够充分。其次，热启动的表现……（原文摘要至此处被截断）
tldr: 该实证研究系统比较了48种配置下每日物品嵌入的跨日兼容性管理方法，发现ID初始化与正交对齐等上游干预能显著提升嵌入对齐质量（余弦相似度最高提升93.4%）并改善多日CTR模型性能（GAUC最高提升2.6%）。
en_tdlr: This empirical study systematically compares 48 configurations for managing cross-day compatibility of daily item embeddings, showing that upstream interventions such as ID initialization and orthogonal alignment substantially improve embedding alignment (cosine up to +93.4%) and enhance multi-day CTR performance (GAUC up to +2.6%).
